svg.title: ZYRIS Interview Coach — fictional coaching walkthrough
svg.desc: Rendered excerpts from a fictional Codex CLI test, not a host UI screenshot. A vague answer receives 3 out of 10. A candidate-written revision receives 7 out of 10 but does not establish stable competence. Stop ends the interview without saving.

g.text: From a vague answer to a clearer next attempt
Fictional Team Lead ERP scenario · Codex CLI test · 2026-11-18
“I would first talk to everyone and then look for a solution together.”
Cooperative intent; risk, ownership and concrete steps are missing.
Editorial summary of the role-specific feedback.
“I first clarify the business time pressure and risks
with the business department and operations.”
A clearer answer; the decision authority still needs clarification.
A coached revision is not independent evidence of stable competence.
“As agreed, nothing is saved” · No further interview question.
English translation of German excerpts · Not a host screenshot · Illustrative scores
